definitions.explanation: Permanently stopping publication of a newspaper, magazine, or other periodical. Usually used intransitively in the form {廃刊|はいかん}になる; {廃刊|はいかん}する, with the publisher as subject, is also common.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{廃刊|はいかん}になった。
{部数|ぶすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧{廃刊|はいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: Circulation fell, and the decision was made to discontinue it.

examples.japanese: {五十年|ごじゅうねん}⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{地方紙|ちほうし}→地方紙：20165_chihoushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{廃刊|はいかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: A local paper that ran for fifty years will end publication this month.

notes:
From {廃|はい} (to abolish) + {刊|かん} (publication).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {廃刊|はいかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to cease publication
- {廃刊|はいかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}まれる→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧: to be forced to cease publication
- {廃刊号|はいかんごう}: the final issue

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{休刊|きゅうかん}→休刊：21658_kyuukan⟧: suspension of publication, which may be temporary; publishers often say ⟦{休刊|きゅうかん}→休刊：21658_kyuukan⟧ even when the end is permanent
- ⟦{創刊|そうかん}→創刊：11923_soukan⟧: launch of a publication (the opposite)
